comment: I024 The Company We Keep: the active achievement collection shown on the cabin laptop. An achievement is a view on the renown records the game already keeps (ObjectiveProgress.completed): it is unlocked when one of its 'records' is completed, or when 'count' records start with 'prefix', or 'generated' (any generated far-harbour objective). Renown is paid by the records themselves, exactly once, as before: the collection never pays anything, so nothing is paid twice. 'reward' is what the record pays (shown for older saves that did not store it). New records (speed, companion, publishing, renown) are awarded by GameSession. Retired objectives (objectives.json 'retired') are not achievements: they remain small renown events. Ids are stable: never rename one.

achievements.title: Channel 16
achievements.text: Answer a call for assistance on the radio.

achievements.text: Average 7 knots under sail for a full hour. Every boat can, in a fresh breeze on a good point of sail.

achievements.title: Tiny Lighthouse 1.0
